title: Anthem of Survivors
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Trumpets, horns, organ, choir and tuba on the seed theme -- militaristic but general, which is a role rather than a situation. Placed deliberately CLOSE to Parade Uniform so the two trade off as the game's broad voice instead of one of them owning it; the weight above 1 is what keeps a general theme surfacing when nothing more specific fits.
